prompt: The 13:57 presence sync (count 0, nothing for @Manager) and the 13:57 agent-watch sync are both ~6 minutes old at your 14:03 run start. Do you run your own DotCollab sync this run?
chosen: Inherit both without re-probing: 6 minutes is inside the 10-minute watcher horizon, and both watchers already logged clean quiet syncs. A fresh sync adds no new state, only load and a race with the next scheduled probe. Keep cadence in the watchers' hands.
rejected: Run a fresh sync for your own independent confirmation — trust nothing inherited, when the body explicitly says to check the latest presence notes before duplicating room work and the notes already say clean.
